novel_features.name: Why was it blocked
novel_features.description: Explain one message in a single verdict: its stage (held, rejected-at-gateway, released-from-hold, rejected-from-hold, the tracking status such as delivery or bounced, or not-found) and why, with policy, reason, spam score, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and who released or rejected it.

novel_features.name: Hold-queue triage sheet
novel_features.description: See the whole hold queue grouped by hold reason, policy or sender domain, with a release-risk class per group and ready-to-act ID batches.

novel_features.name: Guarded release with ticket
novel_features.description: Release held messages after a keyword-based hold-reason check (a heuristic, not verified against every Mimecast hold reason) that refuses impersonation, malware, sandbox and policy holds unless you give an override reason, and record the ticket in a local ledger.

novel_features.name: Purge a flooding sender
novel_features.description: Plan, then with --yes reject, every held message from one sender address or domain, optionally blocking that sender for each recipient it targeted.

novel_features.name: Release accountability audit
novel_features.description: Review who released or rejected held messages over a period, flagging risky releases and marking those with no ticket in the local release-safe ledger.

novel_features.name: Sender permit/block suggestions
novel_features.description: Find senders that keep getting held then released (narrow permit candidates, excluding any with impersonation or malware holds or failed SPF/DKIM/DMARC) or keep getting rejected (block candidates), as a ready managed-sender payload.

novel_features.name: Mail-flow health verdict
novel_features.description: One OK/WARN/FAIL verdict for tenant mail flow: queue backlog, no inbound mail within a window, and stuck deliveries grouped by destination, with a monitor-friendly exit code.

novel_features.name: Who clicked this link
novel_features.description: Given a raw or Mimecast-rewritten URL, list who clicked it, when, whether it was blocked, and whether they clicked through a warning (delivery-time entry scans are not counted as clicks).

novel_features.name: Mailbox threat timeline
novel_features.description: Show every threat event that touched one mailbox over a window, newest first: URL Protect clicks, attachment sandbox verdicts, impersonation hits, gateway rejections and messages held for it, with a per-source fetch report so a failed source never reads as clean.

novel_features.name: Campaign blast radius
novel_features.description: Given a sender address or @domain, list every recipient it reached or tried to reach across URL clicks, attachment verdicts, impersonation hits, rejections and holds, with per-recipient counts by kind, who clicked (clickers first) and the held message IDs.
